unit.why: A single reported statement by R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozdol praising his uncle and teacher R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov: no verse in Tanakh whose secret he did not reveal. There is no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises (ח) of R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov; the series continues from the previous division into the next (ט).
